AcceleratorPartitionConfig.description: Multi-instance GPU (MIG) partition profile and count for fractional accelerator allocation.

Count.description: The number of MIG partitions of the specified Type allocated to the team.

Type.description: MIG profile type. Service rejects MIG profiles that the chosen InstanceType does not support.

ComputeQuotaConfig.description: Compute allocation rules: per-resource quotas, idle-borrowing strategy, and team-task preemption policy.

ComputeQuotaResources.description: Per-instance-type compute quotas for the team. When VCpu / MemoryInGiB / Accelerators are partially specified, SageMaker auto-fills the remaining fields ratio-proportionally to the underlying instance ? Read may return values the customer did not supply (drift may flag this).

PreemptTeamTasks.description: Team-task preemption policy. Defaults service-side to 'LowerPriority' when omitted on Create.

ResourceSharingConfig.description: Idle-resource-sharing strategy for this team's quota. When omitted, the service applies defaults (Strategy=LendAndBorrow, BorrowLimit=50).

ComputeQuotaResourceConfig.description: Per-instance-type compute quota element. Reused under ComputeQuotaConfig.ComputeQuotaResources and ResourceSharingConfig.AbsoluteBorrowLimits.

AcceleratorPartition.description: Multi-instance GPU (MIG) partition profile and count, for fractional accelerator allocation. Service rejects MIG profiles that the chosen InstanceType does not support.

Accelerators.description: The number of accelerators (e.g., GPUs) of this type allocated to the team. SageMaker auto-fills VCpu / MemoryInGiB ratio-proportionally if only this is set.

Count.description: The number of instances of this type allocated to the team.

InstanceType.description: The cluster instance type the quota applies to (e.g., 'ml.m5.xlarge', 'ml.p5.48xlarge'). Validated by the service against the supported HyperPod instance types.

MemoryInGiB.description: The memory in GiB allocated to the team. Floating-point. SageMaker auto-fills Accelerators / VCpu ratio-proportionally if only this is set.

VCpu.description: The number of vCPUs allocated to the team. Floating-point. SageMaker auto-fills Accelerators / MemoryInGiB ratio-proportionally if only this is set.

ComputeQuotaTarget.description: The team this compute allocation rule applies to.

FairShareWeight.description: Relative fair-share weight when fair-share scheduling is enabled on the parent ClusterSchedulerConfig. Defaults service-side to 0 when omitted.

TeamName.description: The name of the team. Materialized as Kubernetes namespace 'hyperpod-ns-<TeamName>' on the EKS cluster, so the value must satisfy RFC 1123 namespace constraints. Reassignment is not supported (createOnly).

ResourceSharingConfig.description: Idle-resource-sharing strategy for this team's quota.

AbsoluteBorrowLimits.description: Per-instance-type absolute caps on resources this team can borrow.

BorrowLimit.description: Maximum percentage of the team's idle quota that can be borrowed by other teams. Smithy admits 0..10000; in practice the service-documented operational range is 1..500. Defaults service-side to 50 when omitted on Create.

Strategy.description: How this team participates in idle-resource sharing.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::ComputeQuota. Defines a compute allocation rule for an EKS-orchestrated SageMaker HyperPod cluster's task governance. Available in 15 regions (us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-1, us-west-2, ap-south-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-2, ap-southeast-3, ap-northeast-1, eu-central-1, eu-west-1, eu-west-2, eu-north-1, eu-south-2, sa-east-1).

ActivationState.description: Whether the compute allocation rule is active. Defaults service-side to 'Enabled' when omitted on Create.

ClusterArn.description: The ARN of the EKS-orchestrated SageMaker HyperPod cluster the compute allocation definition is bound to. Slurm-orchestrated clusters are rejected by the service.

ComputeQuotaArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the compute allocation definition.

ComputeQuotaConfig.description: Compute allocation rules: per-resource quotas, idle-borrowing strategy, and team-task preemption policy.

ComputeQuotaId.description: The unique 12-character identifier of the compute allocation definition.

ComputeQuotaTarget.description: The team this compute allocation rule applies to.

ComputeQuotaVersion.description: The version of the compute allocation definition. Incremented on each successful Update; used for optimistic concurrency control.

CreationTime.description: The ISO-8601 timestamp at which the compute allocation definition was created.

Description.description: A free-form description of the compute allocation definition.

LastModifiedTime.description: The ISO-8601 timestamp at which the compute allocation definition was last modified.

Name.description: The name of the compute allocation definition.

Status.description: The current lifecycle status of the compute allocation definition.

Tags.description: Tags to associate with the compute allocation definition.
